channel.title: Breejesh Rathod | Engineering Blog
channel.description: Engineering articles on Java, cloud, AI agents, system design, and Cracking the Coding Interview.

item.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash: 17% fewer tokens, 350 tok/s Lite, and a cyber specialist
item.description: Google shipped Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber in CodeMender. Benchmarks, $1.50/$7.50 pricing, 350 tok/s, and native computer use.

item.title: Grok 4.5 at ₹6,500/Year: Why SuperGrok Beats ₹24k AI Plans in India
item.description: SuperGrok / Grok 4.5 costs ₹6,500 a year in India vs ~₹24,000 for ChatGPT Plus, Claude Pro, and Gemini. Artificial Analysis benchmarks, live charts, and source credits.

item.title: The 2026 RAM Crisis: How the AI Bubble is Starving Consumer Tech
item.description: How the 2026 memory hardware shortage, the AI data center gold rush, and HBM demand are squeezing PC parts, smartphone prices, and console releases.

item.title: NomAI: The Offline Calorie Tracker Powered by Local LLMs
item.description: An in-depth look at NomAI, the world's first free, open-source, and entirely offline calorie tracking app for Android built with Google Gemma and Jetpack Compose.

item.title: Microsoft's First Cyber Model Hits 96% on CyberGym and Ships Agent Armies

item.title: How an OpenAI Agent Hacked Hugging Face?

item.title: Nvidia's $750B Deals Are the Circular AI Machine on Full Display

item.title: Apple Sues OpenAI: Inside the Stolen Hardware Lawsuit That Shattered Their Alliance

item.title: OpenAI and the AI Bubble Bigger Than Dotcom
